channel.title: Booked: First Day In
channel.desc: In Flagler, it's Fugitive Friday Bingo where the Flagler Sheriff's Office snags a fugitive on the run for grand theft auto. In Virginia Beach, a drunken woman with outstanding warrants bolts from police while heading to the beach. And in Hancock County, two men are booked for traffic violations. It's an action-packed booking day.
